# Editor definitions

This folder is a placeholder. It will hold the files for ADP's editor types, in which typing text is the core interaction:

- **EDSL specification files** (`.eds`), in which a tool engineer specifies one editor type ([EDSL](../../specifications/edsl/EDSL-specification.md));
- **EDD definition files** (`.edd`), each one editor a user created of such a type ([EDD](../../specifications/edd/EDD-specification.md)).

EDSL and EDD are placeholders until an editor needs them. The words used here are defined in [docs/terminology.md](../../docs/terminology.md).
